_comment: Ground rules of the ship (flight_core::ground::GroundTuning, #92): what a ship that rests on the ground does while the SC model does not fly it (no thrust but down, gravity compensation on). Every field required. TODO(initiator): every value here is a placeholder, not designed. cruise_speed m/s: the speed rate_over_speed is read at, as a share of it. linear_decay 1/s: the settle push and the damping to rest decay this times the velocity error. rate rad/s at full stick (pitch and yaw share an ellipse), rate_over_speed: (speed as a share of cruise_speed, share of the rates), angular_accel rad/s² per axis, angular_decay 1/s for the turn rates. landing_slope_limit (#92): degrees; a ship that touches down on ground at most this steep keeps its spot until thrust (any input but down), on steeper ground it is not held.
